Self-explanatory {| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:100%" |- | *Divine Physiology: As the creator of All-Black the Necrosword, he appears to possess the same powers it bestows upon its hosts but to a greater extent. According to Brunnhilde, much of Knull's power and apparent invincibility comes from his metaphysical link to the undead corpse of the Celestial he used to refine All-Black, which feeds him power through the Necrosword and in exchange assimilates the souls of those he kills; serving as a grotesque afterlife. This connection was severed by the Valkyries, thereby greatly weakening Knull, though due to his origin and age, he still remained powerful enough to fight on-par with the likes of All-Father Thor. *Living Abyss Manipulation: As the King in Black, Knull possesses the ability to create, control, and manipulate a fount of eldritch darkness—a manifestation of the primordial void that existed before the universe itself—that he calls the "living abyss". Knull has spent billions of years experimenting with and honing his powers to create not only the parasitic symbiotes, but similar entities such as Mister E and the Exolon. His greatest creations have been All-Black, the Void Knight -- a powerful proto-symbiote created to enslave the Silver Surfer, and the symbiote dragons. During his invasion of Earth, Knull was able to fuse hordes of Symbiote Dragons to engulf the entire Earth in a dome of living abyss, blocking out all light. **Symbiote Creation: Knull first discovered his ability to create life from darkness itself when he manifested All-Black from his shadow in order to kill a Celestial. Experimenting with and honing this aspect of his powers over the eons, he formed a suit of symbiote-armor, constructed an artificial planet, and amassed a horde of wyvern-like monsters from the living abyss. While he initially only infected gods and other cosmic beings with the living abyss; when stranded on a desolate world he discovered he could also infect mortal creatures with the living abyss, creating an army of parasites to conquer the universe by corrupting life instead of simply exterminating it. Knull's early experiments to hone this aspect of his powers resulted in what became known as the Exolon, imperfect symbiotes he discarded as failures. He was also capable of creating symbiotes using his blood, though the only known symbiote created in this manner is Big Mother. **Symbiote Domination: As the divine progenitor of the symbiotes and the nexus of their hive-mind, Knull is able to mentally influence and dominate symbiotes even while sealed away; driving them insane with bloodlust and hunger. He is also capable of remote-piloting them, enabling him to see through their eyes and directly control them; and can manipulate their biomasses even when not in direct contact with them, as demonstrated when he used an ancient dragon-like symbiote to attack Earth and manifest an avatar of his true form. symbiotes infected by Knull's will usually have red spirals in place of their eyespots, and are more powerful than symbiotes disconnected from his dark hive-mind; sometimes even gaining new powers and abilities as a result of the connection. Knull is also capable of forcibly removing symbiotes from their hosts either by psychically blasting them off or by ripping them off with his bare hands. Being one of the primevals of darkness, Knull is also capable of dominating and psychically corrupting other non-symbiote dark entities, such as the Void, Cloak, and Moondragon. Despite not being one of Knull's creations, Ghost-Spider's artificial symbiote was also vulnerable to his psychic corruption. *Superhuman Strength: Knull is strong enough to decapitate a Celestial with a single blow, and singlehandedly slaughtered entire armies of gods augmented by the Uni-Power. At least some of Knull's immense strength is due to him wielding All-Black the Necrosword and his symbiote-armor, which supply him with power from the first Celestial he'd killed. Knull was able to easily manhandle the Silver Surfer - albeit after Norrin had exhausted the majority of his Power Cosmic, and easily overpowered the Sentry - touted as one of Earth's strongest heroes - and effortlessly tore him in half. Even after the Valkyries severed his metaphysical connection to the Headless Celestial, Knull was still strong enough to fight Thor Odinson - who possessed a small portion of the Power of the All-Father. The avatars that Knull creates using his symbiotes possess only a fraction of his true power, but are nevertheless able to easily overpower the likes of Venom despite Eddie Brock being simultaneously bonded to both the Venom and Tyrannosaurus symbiotes. *Superhuman

intelligence.text: Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. *Blades: Although firmly against the use of such a form of weaponry at first, Kraven has progressively adopted the habit of carrying hunting knives and spears of different makings at any given time. *Belt Tusks: Kraven sports a unique collection of tusks circling around his waist. These items are more than just ornaments, for they brim with drugs, poisons and even medicines which quickly affect their victim through even a mere scratch. More specific examples include concentrated black mamba venom, neural poisons, tranquilizers, antidotesSpider-Man: Blue Vol 1 5X-Men: The Hidden Years Vol 1 17 and the n'gami, a powerful drug that eases pain and acts as a disinfectant.Ka-Zar the Savage Vol 1 21 In more recent years, Kraven has occasionally traded this classic belt with a more conventional one, featuring different pouches instead of tusks. In yet other instances, Kraven has combined the two articles by hanging the tusks to strings circling around his waist and right next to his belt. *Lion Vest: An energy-based weapon developed by Kraven over the course of several months spent in prison. It consists of a tangle of wires hidden behind the two lion eyes on his jacket which project electric rays which disable the victim's muscular system. Kraven has rebuilt and improved such a weapon several times, adding further offensive options such as stun beams, sleeping gas and sonic beams. Kraven has also implemented a gas specifically designed to knock out Tigra. Kraven has never abandoned his signature vest, but following his resurrection he ceased to employ it as a weapon, leaving it dubious whether he refuses to use it or has truly reverted it into normal clothing. thumb|center|250px|Lion VestSpider-Man: Grim Hunt - The Kraven Saga Vol 1 1 *Cold Weapons and Firearms: Bolas, spears,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 634 whip, war axe, war club, wooden staff, sword, shield, telescopic harpoon, rifle (loaded with darts or bullets), assault rifle, grenades, electric baton, sniper rifle, handheld rocket launcher and .585 Gehringer. **Garrote: A sturdy wire with which Kraven attempted to strangle the Man-Wolf after catching him from behind.Creatures on the Loose Vol 1 32 **Plasti-Cord: A long and stiff string hidden within Kraven's belt. He used it as lasso to snare Ka-Zar's neck and attempt to hang him on a tree. **Poison Ring: A ring featuring a large spike dipped in toxins. A single sting could induce strong dizziness into Spider-Man. **Anti-Vampire Javelin: A folding spear with a silver blade mounted on a wooden shaft. Kraven used it to deliver a seemingly lethal blow to Baron Blood. **Bear-Trap Bazooka: A rocket launcher loaded with foothold traps which clench automatically upon hitting the target. It stores at least two traps, as Kraven has used it to distract the Hulk and then free himself from a sasquatch's clutch briefly after. **Net Guns: Pistols and rifles loaded with nets wide enough to capture whole individuals such as Squirrel Girl and the Dinosaur-People.Venom Vol 1 158 **Adamantium Blade: Long knives made by the famous nearly-indestructible metal. Kraven owns at least two of such blades. *Nets: One of Kraven's favorite items, useful to quickly snare an opponent and render them helpless. Far from being common nets, they can be sturdy enough to overcome even Spider-Man's strength or progressively tighten the more the target struggles to free themselves.Astonishing Tales Vol 1 2 *Darts: Sharp projectiles imbued with poisons and drugs. They are thrown by hand or propelled by means such as a wrist device, a blowgun or a rifle. *Ropes: Mundane tools used for a variety of purposes, such as tying people, swinging away to safety or quickly rise through surfaces when connected to a pulley device. *Adamantium Fishhooks: Hooked wires made of the famous and near-indestructible metal. Kraven uses them to fish megalodons, but has also employed a tangle of them to snare the Hulk and lift him up in the air with a remote-controlled air balloon connected to the fishooks. *Adamantium Cage: A container with bars forged in Adamantium, durable enough to be impervious even to Old Man Logan's own Adamantium claws. *Animals: Kraven is occasionally escorted by the wild beasts he has tamed and trained to assist him in combat. Some specimen include leopards, tigers, lions and hawks. *Jungle Drum: A particularly loud percussion instrument whose sounds confuse the enemy. *Magnetic Manacles: Magnetized metal bracers whose reciprocal attraction increases progressively. They come with built-in bells which jingle with every movement, allowing Kraven to follow his prey as they struggle to break free. *Jungle Scent: An exotic aroma which disabled Spider-Man's Spider Sense and made him easier to track. *Malodorous Juices: A gourd filled with liquids whose odor could overload Tigra's enhanced senses. *Electric Band: A metal band that discharges electricity. It was used by Kraven to knock out the powerful sabertooth Zabu. *Ivory Horn: An artifact from ancien

Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. Notes: *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. *Despite being a frequent and historical foe of Spider-Man, Kraven has been recurrently stated to be the weaker among the two, also failing to actually injure Spider-Man with his punches and being swiftly overpowered during contests of pure strength. Kraven has also never come close to overcoming Spider-Man in a direct confrontation without first weakening him through poisons, drugs or other underhand strategies. Moreover, Kraven's has been either stated and/or shown to be weakerTales of Suspense Vol 2 58Old Man Logan Vol 2 42 than the likes of Iron Man, Tigra, Beast, Kaine and Old Man Logan. ==Notable Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. *Blades: Although firmly against the use of such a form of weaponry at first, Kraven has progressively adopted the habit of carrying hunting knives and spears of different makings at any given time. *Belt Tusks: Kraven sports a unique collection of tusks circling around his waist. These items are more than just ornaments, for they brim with drugs, poisons and even medicines which quickly affect their victim through even a mere scratch. More specific examples include concentrated black mamba venom, neural poisons, tranquilizers, antidotesSpider-Man: Blue Vol 1 5X-Men: The Hidden Years Vol 1 17 and the n'gami, a powerful drug that eases pain and acts as a disinfectant.Ka-Zar the Savage Vol 1 21 In more recent years, Kraven has occasionally traded this classic belt with a more conventional one, featuring different pouches instead of tusks. In yet other instances, Kraven has combined the two articles by hanging the tusks to strings circling around his waist and right next to his belt. *Lion Vest: An energy-based weapon developed by Kraven over the course of several months spent in prison. It consists of a tangle of wires hidden behind the two lion eyes on his jacket which project electric rays which disable the victim's muscular system. Kraven has rebuilt and improved such a weapon several times, adding further offensive options such as stun beams, sleeping gas and sonic beams. Kraven has also implemented a gas specifically designed to knock out Tigra. Kraven has never abandoned his signature vest, but following his resurrection he ceased to employ it as a weapon, leaving it dubious whether he refuses to use it or has truly reverted it into normal clothing. thumb|center|250px|Lion VestSpider-Man: Grim Hunt - The Kraven Saga Vol 1 1 *Cold Weapons and Firearms: Bolas, spears,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 634 whip, war axe, war club, wooden staff, sword, shield, telescopic harpoon, rifle (loaded with darts or bullets), assault rifle, grenades, electric baton, sniper rifle, handheld rocket launcher and .585 Gehringer. **Garrote: A sturdy wire with which Kraven attempted to strangle the Man-Wolf after catching him from behind.Creatures on the Loose Vol 1 32 **Plasti-Cord: A long and stiff string hidden within Kraven's belt. He used it as lasso to snare Ka-Zar's neck and attempt to hang him on a tree. **Poison Ring: A ring featuring a large spike dipped in toxins. A single sting could induce strong dizziness into Spider-Man. **Anti-Vampire Javelin: A folding spear with a silver blade mounted on a wooden shaft. Kraven used it to deliver a seemingly lethal blow to Baron Blood. **Bear-Trap Bazooka: A rocket launcher loaded with foothold traps which clench automatically upon hitting the target. It stores at least two traps, as Kraven has used it to distract the Hulk and then free himself from a sasquatch's clutch briefly after. **Net Guns: Pistols and rifles loaded with nets wide enough to capture whole individuals such as Squirrel Girl and the Dinosaur-People.Venom Vol 1 158 **Adamantium Blade: Long knives made by the famous nearly-indestructible metal. Kraven owns at least two of such blades. *Nets: One of Kraven's favorite items, useful to quickly snare an opponent and render them helpless. Far from being common nets, they can be sturdy enough to overcome even Spider-Man's strength or progressively tighten the more the target struggles to free themselves.Astonishing Tales Vol 1 2 *Darts: Sharp projectiles imbued with poisons and drugs. They are thrown by hand or propelled by means such as a wrist device, a blowgun or a rifle. *Ropes: Mundane tools used for a variety of purposes, such as tying people, swinging away to safety or quickly rise through surfaces when connected to a pulley device. *Adamantium Fishhooks: Hooked wires made of the famous and near-indestructible metal. Kraven uses them to fish megalodons, but has also employed a tangle of them to snare the Hulk and lift him up in the air with a remote-controlled air balloon connected to the fishooks. *Adamantium Cage: A container with bars forged in Adamantium, durable enough to be impervious even to Old Man Logan's own Adamantium claws. *Animals: Kraven is occasionally escorted by the wild beasts he has tamed and trained to assist him in combat. Some specimen include leopards, tigers, lions and hawks. *Jungle Drum: A particularly loud percussion instrument whose sounds confuse the enemy. *Magnetic Manacles: Magnetized metal bracers whose reciprocal attraction increases progressively. They come with built-in bells which jingle with every movement, allowing Kraven to follow his prey as they struggle to break free. *Jungle Scent: An exotic aroma which disabled Spider-Man's Spider Sense and made him easier to track. *Malodorous Juices: A gourd filled with liquids whose odor could overload Tigra's enhanced senses. *Electric Band: A metal band that discharges electricity. It was used by Kraven to knock out the powerful sabertooth Zabu. *Ivory Horn: An artifact from ancien

Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. Notes: *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. *Despite being a frequent and historical foe of Spider-Man, Kraven has been recurrently stated to be the weaker among the two, also failing to actually injure Spider-Man with his punches and being swiftly overpowered during contests of pure strength. Kraven has also never come close to overcoming Spider-Man in a direct confrontation without first weakening him through poisons, drugs or other underhand strategies. Moreover, Kraven's has been either stated and/or shown to be weakerTales of Suspense Vol 2 58Old Man Logan Vol 2 42 than the likes of Iron Man, Tigra, Beast, Kaine and Old Man Logan. ==Notable Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. intelligence.text: Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. *Blades: Although firmly against the use of such a form of weaponry at first, Kraven has progressively adopted the habit of carrying hunting knives and spears of different makings at any given time. *Belt Tusks: Kraven sports a unique collection of tusks circling around his waist. These items are more than just ornaments, for they brim with drugs, poisons and even medicines which quickly affect their victim through even a mere scratch. More specific examples include concentrated black mamba venom, neural poisons, tranquilizers, antidotesSpider-Man: Blue Vol 1 5X-Men: The Hidden Years Vol 1 17 and the n'gami, a powerful drug that eases pain and acts as a disinfectant.Ka-Zar the Savage Vol 1 21 In more recent years, Kraven has occasionally traded this classic belt with a more conventional one, featuring different pouches instead of tusks. In yet other instances, Kraven has combined the two articles by hanging the tusks to strings circling around his waist and right next to his belt. *Lion Vest: An energy-based weapon developed by Kraven over the course of several months spent in prison. It consists of a tangle of wires hidden behind the two lion eyes on his jacket which project electric rays which disable the victim's muscular system. Kraven has rebuilt and improved such a weapon several times, adding further offensive options such as stun beams, sleeping gas and sonic beams. Kraven has also implemented a gas specifically designed to knock out Tigra. Kraven has never abandoned his signature vest, but following his resurrection he ceased to employ it as a weapon, leaving it dubious whether he refuses to use it or has truly reverted it into normal clothing. thumb|center|250px|Lion VestSpider-Man: Grim Hunt - The Kraven Saga Vol 1 1 *Cold Weapons and Firearms: Bolas, spears,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 634 whip, war axe, war club, wooden staff, sword, shield, telescopic harpoon, rifle (loaded with darts or bullets), assault rifle, grenades, electric baton, sniper rifle, handheld rocket launcher and .585 Gehringer. **Garrote: A sturdy wire with which Kraven attempted to strangle the Man-Wolf after catching him from behind.Creatures on the Loose Vol 1 32 **Plasti-Cord: A long and stiff string hidden within Kraven's belt. He used it as lasso to snare Ka-Zar's neck and attempt to hang him on a tree. **Poison Ring: A ring featuring a large spike dipped in toxins. A single sting could induce strong dizziness into Spider-Man. **Anti-Vampire Javelin: A folding spear with a silver blade mounted on a wooden shaft. Kraven used it to deliver a seemingly lethal blow to Baron Blood. **Bear-Trap Bazooka: A rocket launcher loaded with foothold traps which clench automatically upon hitting the target. It stores at least two traps, as Kraven has used it to distract the Hulk and then free himself from a sasquatch's clutch briefly after. **Net Guns: Pistols and rifles loaded with nets wide enough to capture whole individuals such as Squirrel Girl and the Dinosaur-People.Venom Vol 1 158 **Adamantium Blade: Long knives made by the famous nearly-indestructible metal. Kraven owns at least two of such blades. *Nets: One of Kraven's favorite items, useful to quickly snare an opponent and render them helpless. Far from being common nets, they can be sturdy enough to overcome even Spider-Man's strength or progressively tighten the more the target struggles to free themselves.Astonishing Tales Vol 1 2 *Darts: Sharp projectiles imbued with poisons and drugs. They are thrown by hand or propelled by means such as a wrist device, a blowgun or a rifle. *Ropes: Mundane tools used for a variety of purposes, such as tying people, swinging away to safety or quickly rise through surfaces when connected to a pulley device. *Adamantium Fishhooks: Hooked wires made of the famous and near-indestructible metal. Kraven uses them to fish megalodons, but has also employed a tangle of them to snare the Hulk and lift him up in the air with a remote-controlled air balloon connected to the fishooks. *Adamantium Cage: A container with bars forged in Adamantium, durable enough to be impervious even to Old Man Logan's own Adamantium claws. *Animals: Kraven is occasionally escorted by the wild beasts he has tamed and trained to assist him in combat. Some specimen include leopards, tigers, lions and hawks. *Jungle Drum: A particularly loud percussion instrument whose sounds confuse the enemy. *Magnetic Manacles: Magnetized metal bracers whose reciprocal attraction increases progressively. They come with built-in bells which jingle with every movement, allowing Kraven to follow his prey as they struggle to break free. *Jungle Scent: An exotic aroma which disabled Spider-Man's Spider Sense and made him easier to track. *Malodorous Juices: A gourd filled with liquids whose odor could overload Tigra's enhanced senses. *Electric Band: A metal band that discharges electricity. It was used by Kraven to knock out the powerful sabertooth Zabu. *Ivory Horn: An artifact from ancien

*Blades: Although firmly against the use of such a form of weaponry at first, Kraven has progressively adopted the habit of carrying hunting knives and spears of different makings at any given time. *Belt Tusks: Kraven sports a unique collection of tusks circling around his waist. These items are more than just ornaments, for they brim with drugs, poisons and even medicines which quickly affect their victim through even a mere scratch. More specific examples include concentrated black mamba venom, neural poisons, tranquilizers, antidotesSpider-Man: Blue Vol 1 5X-Men: The Hidden Years Vol 1 17 and the n'gami, a powerful drug that eases pain and acts as a disinfectant.Ka-Zar the Savage Vol 1 21 In more recent years, Kraven has occasionally traded this classic belt with a more conventional one, featuring different pouches instead of tusks. In yet other instances, Kraven has combined the two articles by hanging the tusks to strings circling around his waist and right next to his belt. *Lion Vest: An energy-based weapon developed by Kraven over the course of several months spent in prison. It consists of a tangle of wires hidden behind the two lion eyes on his jacket which project electric rays which disable the victim's muscular system. Kraven has rebuilt and improved such a weapon several times, adding further offensive options such as stun beams, sleeping gas and sonic beams. Kraven has also implemented a gas specifically designed to knock out Tigra. Kraven has never abandoned his signature vest, but following his resurrection he ceased to employ it as a weapon, leaving it dubious whether he refuses to use it or has truly reverted it into normal clothing. thumb|center|250px|Lion VestSpider-Man: Grim Hunt - The Kraven Saga Vol 1 1 *Cold Weapons and Firearms: Bolas, spears,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 634 whip, war axe, war club, wooden staff, sword, shield, telescopic harpoon, rifle (loaded with darts or bullets), assault rifle, grenades, electric baton, sniper rifle, handheld rocket launcher and .585 Gehringer. **Garrote: A sturdy wire with which Kraven attempted to strangle the Man-Wolf after catching him from behind.Creatures on the Loose Vol 1 32 **Plasti-Cord: A long and stiff string hidden within Kraven's belt. He used it as lasso to snare Ka-Zar's neck and attempt to hang him on a tree. **Poison Ring: A ring featuring a large spike dipped in toxins. A single sting could induce strong dizziness into Spider-Man. **Anti-Vampire Javelin: A folding spear with a silver blade mounted on a wooden shaft. Kraven used it to deliver a seemingly lethal blow to Baron Blood. **Bear-Trap Bazooka: A rocket launcher loaded with foothold traps which clench automatically upon hitting the target. It stores at least two traps, as Kraven has used it to distract the Hulk and then free himself from a sasquatch's clutch briefly after. **Net Guns: Pistols and rifles loaded with nets wide enough to capture whole individuals such as Squirrel Girl and the Dinosaur-People.Venom Vol 1 158 **Adamantium Blade: Long knives made by the famous nearly-indestructible metal. Kraven owns at least two of such blades. *Nets: One of Kraven's favorite items, useful to quickly snare an opponent and render them helpless. Far from being common nets, they can be sturdy enough to overcome even Spider-Man's strength or progressively tighten the more the target struggles to free themselves.Astonishing Tales Vol 1 2 *Darts: Sharp projectiles imbued with poisons and drugs. They are thrown by hand or propelled by means such as a wrist device, a blowgun or a rifle. *Ropes: Mundane tools used for a variety of purposes, such as tying people, swinging away to safety or quickly rise through surfaces when connected to a pulley device. *Adamantium Fishhooks: Hooked wires made of the famous and near-indestructible metal. Kraven uses them to fish megalodons, but has also employed a tangle of them to snare the Hulk and lift him up in the air with a remote-controlled air balloon connected to the fishooks. *Adamantium Cage: A container with bars forged in Adamantium, durable enough to be impervious even to Old Man Logan's own Adamantium claws. *Animals: Kraven is occasionally escorted by the wild beasts he has tamed and trained to assist him in combat. Some specimen include leopards, tigers, lions and hawks. *Jungle Drum: A particularly loud percussion instrument whose sounds confuse the enemy. *Magnetic Manacles: Magnetized metal bracers whose reciprocal attraction increases progressively. They come with built-in bells which jingle with every movement, allowing Kraven to follow his prey as they struggle to break free. *Jungle Scent: An exotic aroma which disabled Spider-Man's Spider Sense and made him easier to track. *Malodorous Juices: A gourd filled with liquids whose odor could overload Tigra's enhanced senses. *Electric Band: A metal band that discharges electricity. It was used by Kraven to knock out the powerful sabertooth Zabu. *Ivory Horn: An artifact from ancien

Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. Notes: *Before making any changes to this page, please read and follow the Power-scaling Rules for Marvel and DC Comics. *Despite being a frequent and historical foe of Spider-Man, Kraven has been recurrently stated to be the weaker among the two, also failing to actually injure Spider-Man with his punches and being swiftly overpowered during contests of pure strength. Kraven has also never come close to overcoming Spider-Man in a direct confrontation without first weakening him through poisons, drugs or other underhand strategies. Moreover, Kraven's has been either stated and/or shown to be weakerTales of Suspense Vol 2 58Old Man Logan Vol 2 42 than the likes of Iron Man, Tigra, Beast, Kaine and Old Man Logan. ==Notable Genius Sergei has received the upbringing that is expected from a member of the russian nobility of his time and overtime he has displayed profound knowledge and interest for topics such as music, literature, poetry and philosophy, with particular fondness for the productions of his homeland.Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 33Unbeatable Squirrel Girl Vol 2 35 During his early adulthood, Sergei has received further education from Aja Orisha, who introduced him to the ways of natural mysticism that she had in turn acquired as a Wakandan mystic.Spider-Man: The Lost Hunt Vol 1 4 Kraven has gained worldwide fame as a legendary hunter over the course of many decades, earning such a reputation by single-handedly hunting every type of beast that walks, climbs, crawls, flies and swims, even going as far as doing it unarmed.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 15Amazing Spider-Man Annual Vol 1 1 Further explorations on his life revealed that Kraven has also hunted cryptids (such as the yeti or the Sasquatch), many species of dinosaurs and creatures that don't exist anymore or "were never meant to have existed in the first place".Incredible Hulk Vol 3 11 Upon having been given a second chance to life, Kraven set off to hunt even more bizarre game, succeeding in the capture of creatures such as the Winged Tigers of K'un-Lun, the Gamma Wolves and a Giganto. His latest collection of trophies also features several humans, masked individuals and humanoid monsters.Captain America Vol 1 697 Another of his great feats has been the repetead breaching of the High Evolutionary's defenses and security in order to relentlessly hunt down his Ani-Men.Amazing Spider-Man Vol 5 16 Consequently, he has also become an expert survivalist, having spent many years in the wildest environments of the world and having grown capable of navigating even places such as the Savage Land,Amazing Spider-Man Vol 1 104 a place from which he managed to return from even after suffering a broken arm and that has eventually become his residing place after his resurrection in modern times. Furthermore, given his extended lifespan, Kraven has accumulated a wealth of life experience spanning approximately a century. Kraven is a man of many talents, which he has acquired and honed over the course of his adventures, as better detailed in the Powers&Abilities section above. Kraven is also a clever inventor, having personally developed the various weapons hidden inside his lion vest and having synthesized new gases and drugs designed to specifically affect Tigra and Spider-Man. Moreover, he is an proficient cook, can craft various weapons and is able to consistently replicate numerous potions and magic spells. An excellent instructor as well, Kraven has trained the Gibbon, the Alien Killing Krew, his pupil Gregor and his children Vladimir,Spider-Man Vol 1 50 Alyosha, AnastasiaSpider-Girl Vol 2 4 and his 87 clones created by the High Evolutionary. Kraven has always maintained the Kravinoff family's business and estate in wealth and respectability, even seemingly forming his own small kingdom at some point. Aside from his native russian and his naturalized english, Kraven also speaks fluent japaneseOld Man Logan Vol 2 41 and may have acquired other languages during his many travels. In combat, Kraven has faced a remarkably numerous and varied amount of opponents, often representing a challenge, if not a dangerous thorn in their side. His martial skills, weapons and traps have allowed him to hold his own against foes both stronger and faster than him, while his many gadgets and tactics have allowed Kraven to come victorious and capture his preys in numerous occasions, being defeated only at the very end because of his hubris and will to achieve victory on his own terms. The selection of preys confronted by Kraven in one or multiple instances include Spider-Man, Scarlet Spider/Kaine, Venom, Tigra, Daredevil, Black Widow, Ka-Zar, Man-Wolf, Vermin, Rocket Raccoon, Black Panther, Hulk, Squirrel Girl, Captain America, Old Man Logan and even the entire, original formation of the X-Men all together. Standard Tactics: At the beginning of his criminal career, Kraven adhered to a self-imposed rule of confronting his opponents without the aid of weapons, for he went proud of having always bested his preys with none but his bare hands. Nonetheless, he was also prone to first test his targets with subtler approaches, such as leading them into convenient locations rigged with traps or surprising them with sneak attacks and special tools meant to hinder and misdirect them. Therefore, Kraven used to leave close combat only for those skilled enough to evade his tricks. For a time he has also been a hyprocritical fighter, ready to betray his own code of honor once the odds of the battle turned against him, resorting to dirty maneuvers and hidden weapons to achieve victory whenever strength alone did not suffice. During the time which eventually led to his Last Hunt, Kraven gradually underwent a cha

The physical augmentations granted to Kraven by the elixir are temporary, therefore he must regularly ingest new doses in order to maintain his superhuman powers. Moreover, around the period which preceded his "Last Hunt", his serum's toll on Kraven's body after decades of consumption had become unsustainable, thus leaving him on borrowed time he himself wasn't aware of. Arrongant and full of himself, Kraven often underestimates his opponents even after having studied or confronted them directly, refusing to accept his physical inferiority. As noted by Spider-Man, he is also susceptible to taunts, which make him careless in battle. Kraven has somewhat toned down his arrogance overtime, wanting to restore his lost honor, but he nonetheless maintained eccessive levels of self-confidence which proved to be his downfall time and time again. Knull is also capable of forcibly removing symbiotes from their hosts either by psychically blasting them off or by ripping them off with his bare hands. Being one of the primevals of darkness, Knull is also capable of dominating and psychically corrupting other non-symbiote dark entities, such as the Void, Cloak, and Moondragon.
